functions.name: validate_entity_subtype
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION catalog.validate_entity_subtype()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'catalog', 'operations', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            expected_entity_type text;
            actual_entity_type text;
        BEGIN
            IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'entity' THEN
                IF EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM catalog.product AS product
                    WHERE product.dataset_version = NEW.dataset_version
                      AND product.entity_id = NEW.entity_id
                      AND NEW.entity_type <> 'product'
                ) OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM catalog.security AS security
                    WHERE security.dataset_version = NEW.dataset_version
                      AND security.entity_id = NEW.entity_id
                      AND NEW.entity_type <> 'security'
                ) OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM catalog.institution AS institution
                    WHERE institution.dataset_version = NEW.dataset_version
                      AND institution.entity_id = NEW.entity_id
                      AND NEW.entity_type <> 'institution'
                ) THEN
                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ENTITY_SUBTYPE_MISMATCH'
                        USING ERRCODE = '23514';
                END IF;
                RETURN NEW;
            END IF;

            expected_entity_type := CASE TG_TABLE_NAME
                WHEN 'product' THEN 'product'
                WHEN 'security' THEN 'security'
                WHEN 'institution' THEN 'institution'
            END;
            SELECT entity.entity_type
              INTO actual_entity_type
              FROM catalog.entity AS entity
             WHERE entity.dataset_version = NEW.dataset_version
               AND entity.entity_id = NEW.entity_id
             FOR KEY SHARE;
            IF actual_entity_type IS DISTINCT FROM expected_entity_type THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'ENTITY_SUBTYPE_MISMATCH'
                    USING ERRCODE = '23514';
            END IF;
            RETURN NEW;
        END
        $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION evidence.reject_calculation_cycle()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'evidence', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS (
                WITH RECURSIVE dependency_path(calculation_id) AS (
                    SELECT NEW.input_calculation_id
                    UNION
                    SELECT edge.input_calculation_id
                      FROM evidence.calculation_dependency AS edge
                      JOIN dependency_path AS path
                        ON edge.calculation_id = path.calculation_id
                     WHERE edge.run_id = NEW.run_id
                )
                SELECT 1
                  FROM dependency_path
                 WHERE calculation_id = NEW.calculation_id
            ) THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'CALCULATION_CYCLE'
                    USING ERRCODE = '23514';
            END IF;
            RETURN NEW;
        END
        $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION evidence.validate_evidence_origin()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'evidence', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            stored_kind text;
            observation_count integer;
            relation_count integer;
            document_count integer;
        BEGIN
            SELECT evidence_kind
              INTO stored_kind
              FROM evidence.evidence_record
             WHERE dataset_version = NEW.dataset_version
               AND evidence_id = NEW.evidence_id;
            IF stored_kind IS NULL THEN
                RETURN NEW;
            END IF;

            SELECT count(*) INTO observation_count
              FROM evidence.evidence_observation_origin
             WHERE dataset_version = NEW.dataset_version
               AND evidence_id = NEW.evidence_id;
            SELECT count(*) INTO relation_count
              FROM evidence.evidence_relation_origin
             WHERE dataset_version = NEW.dataset_version
               AND evidence_id = NEW.evidence_id;
            SELECT count(*) INTO document_count
              FROM evidence.evidence_document_origin
             WHERE dataset_version = NEW.dataset_version
               AND evidence_id = NEW.evidence_id;

            IF NOT (
                (stored_kind = 'observation'
                 AND observation_count = 1
                 AND relation_count = 0 AND document_count = 0)
                OR (stored_kind = 'relation'
                    AND relation_count = 1
                    AND observation_count = 0 AND document_count = 0)
                OR (stored_kind = 'document_span'
                    AND document_count = 1
                    AND observation_count = 0 AND relation_count = 0)
                OR (stored_kind IN ('query_scope','exclusion','policy')
                    AND observation_count = 0
                    AND relation_count = 0 AND document_count = 0)
            ) THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_EVIDENCE_ORIGIN'
                    USING ERRCODE = '23514';
            END IF;
            RETURN NEW;
        END
        $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION evidence.validate_source_publisher_type()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'evidence', 'catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            publisher_entity_type text;
        BEGIN
            SELECT entity.entity_type
              INTO publisher_entity_type
              FROM catalog.entity AS entity
             WHERE entity.dataset_version = NEW.dataset_version
               AND entity.entity_id = NEW.publisher
             FOR KEY SHARE;
            IF publisher_entity_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'institution' THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'SOURCE_PUBLISHER_NOT_INSTITUTION'
                    USING ERRCODE = '23514';
            END IF;
            RETURN NEW;
        END
        $function$

functions.name: validate_metric_value_kind
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION observation.validate_metric_value_kind()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'observation', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            registered_value_kind text;
            stored_value_kind text;
        BEGIN
            SELECT metric.value_kind
              INTO registered_value_kind
              FROM observation.metric_definition AS metric
             WHERE metric.metric_id = NEW.metric_id
               AND metric.definition_version = NEW.metric_definition_version
             FOR KEY SHARE;

            stored_value_kind := CASE
                WHEN NEW.numeric_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
                WHEN NEW.text_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'text'
                WHEN NEW.boolean_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'boolean'
                WHEN NEW.date_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'date'
                WHEN NEW.timestamp_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'timestamp'
                ELSE NULL
            END;
            IF NEW.value_status = 'zero' THEN
                stored_value_kind := 'numeric';
            END IF;
            IF stored_value_kind IS NOT NULL
               AND stored_value_kind IS DISTINCT FROM registered_value_kind THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'METRIC_VALUE_KIND_MISMATCH'
                    USING ERRCODE = '23514';
            END IF;
            RETURN NEW;
        END
        $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION operations.append_request_artifact(p_artifact_type text, p_model_id text, p_prompt_version text, p_canonical_payload text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'operations', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            inserted_artifact operations.request_artifact%ROWTYPE;
            existing_artifact operations.request_artifact%ROWTYPE;
            candidate_jsonb jsonb;
            candidate_hash character(64);
            candidate_contract_id text;
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO operations.request_artifact (
                artifact_type, model_id, prompt_version, canonical_payload
            ) VALUES (
                p_artifact_type, p_model_id, p_prompt_version, p_canonical_payload
            )
            ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
            RETURNING * INTO inserted_artifact;

            IF NOT FOUND THEN
                candidate_jsonb := p_canonical_payload::jsonb;
                candidate_hash := pg_catalog.encode(
                    public.digest(p_canonical_payload, 'sha256'), 'hex'
                );
                candidate_contract_id := CASE p_artifact_type
                    WHEN 'execution_graph' THEN candidate_jsonb ->> 'graph_id'
                    WHEN 'tool_result' THEN candidate_jsonb ->> 'task_id'
                    WHEN 'evidence_bundle' THEN candidate_jsonb ->> 'bundle_id'
                    WHEN 'verification_report'
                        THEN candidate_jsonb ->> 'verification_report_id'
                    ELSE NULL
                END;
                SELECT artifact.*
                  INTO existing_artifact
                  FROM operations.request_artifact AS artifact
                 WHERE artifact.run_id = candidate_jsonb ->> 'run_id'
                   AND artifact.artifact_type = p_artifact_type
                   AND (
                       artifact.payload_hash = candidate_hash
                       OR (
                           candidate_contract_id IS NOT NULL
                           AND artifact.contract_object_id = candidate_contract_id
                       )
                   )
                 ORDER BY artifact.artifact_record_id
                 LIMIT 1;
                IF FOUND
                   AND existing_artifact.canonical_payload = p_canonical_payload
                   AND existing_artifact.model_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_model_id
                   AND existing_artifact.prompt_version
                       IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_prompt_version
                THEN
                    RETURN existing_artifact.artifact_record_id;
                END IF;
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'ARTIFACT_CONFLICT'
                    USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
            END IF;

            IF inserted_artifact.artifact_type = 'query_plan' THEN
                INSERT INTO operations.request_subtask (
                    run_id, subtask_id, importance
                )
                SELECT inserted_artifact.run_id,
                       subtask.value ->> 'subtask_id',
                       subtask.value ->> 'importance'
                  FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(
                      COALESCE(
                          inserted_artifact.payload_jsonb -> 'subtasks', '[]'::jsonb
                      )
                  ) AS subtask(value);
            ELSIF inserted_artifact.artifact_type = 'tool_result' THEN
                INSERT INTO operations.artifact_evidence_ref (
                    artifact_record_id, run_id, dataset_version, evidence_id,
                    reference_role, ordinal
                )
                SELECT inserted_artifact.artifact_record_id,
                       inserted_artifact.run_id,
                       inserted_artifact.dataset_version,
                       reference.value,
                       'result',
                       reference.ordinality - 1
                  FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements_text(
                      COALESCE(
                          inserted_artifact.payload_jsonb -> 'evidence_refs',
                          '[]'::jsonb
                      )
                  ) WITH ORDINALITY AS reference(value, ordinality);
            ELSIF inserted_artifact.artifact_type = 'evidence_bundle' THEN
                INSERT INTO operations.artifact_evidence_ref (
                    artifact_record_id, run_id, dataset_version, evidence_id,
                    reference_role, ordinal
                )
                SELECT inserted_artifact.artifact_record_id,
                       inserted_artifact.run_id,
                       inserted_artifact.dataset_version,
                       reference.value,
                       'included',
                       reference.ordinality - 1
                  FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements_text(
                      COALESCE(
                          inserted_artifact.payload_jsonb -> 'evidence_ids',
                          '[]'::jsonb
                      )
                  ) WITH ORDINALITY AS reference(value, ordinality);
                INSERT INTO operations.artifact_evidence_ref (
                    artifact_record_id, run_id, dataset_version, evidence_id,
                    reference_role, ordinal
                )
                SELECT inserted_artifact.artifact_record_id,
                       inserted_artifact.run_id,
                       inserted_artifact.dataset_version,
                       reference.value,
                       'exclusion',
                       reference.ordinality - 1
                  FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements_text(
                      COALESCE(
                          inserted_artifact.payload_jsonb
                              -> 'exclusion_evidence_ids',
                          '[]'::jsonb
                      )
                  ) WITH ORDINALITY AS reference(value, ordinality);
                INSERT INTO operations.artifact_evidence_ref (
                    artifact_record_id, run_id, dataset_version, evidence_id,
                    reference_role, ordinal
                )
                SELECT inserted_artifact.artifact_record_id,
                       inserted_artifact.run_id,
                       inserted_artifact.dataset_version,
                       flattened.evidence_id,
                       'limitation',
                       pg_catalog.row_number() OVER (
                           ORDER BY flattened.limitation_ordinal,
                                    flattened.evidence_ordinal
                       ) - 1
                  FROM (
                      SELECT evidence.value AS evidence_id,
                             limitation.ordinality AS limitation_ordinal,
                             evidence.ordinality AS evidence_ordinal
                        FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(
                            COALESCE(
                                inserted_artifact.payload_jsonb -> 'limitations',
                                '[]'::jsonb
                            )
                        ) WITH ORDINALITY AS limitation(value, ordinality)
                        CROSS JOIN LATERAL
                            pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements_text(
                                COALESCE(
                                    limitation.value -> 'related_evidence_ids',
                                    '[]'::jsonb
                                )
                            ) WITH ORDINALITY AS evidence(value, ordinality)
                  ) AS flattened;
                INSERT INTO operations.artifact_calculation_ref (
                    artifact_record_id, run_id, dataset_version, calculation_id,
                    reference_role, ordinal
                )
                SELECT inserted_artifact.artifact_record_id,
                       inserted_artifact.run_id,
                       inserted_artifact.dataset_version,
                       reference.value,
                       'included',
                       reference.ordinality - 1
                  FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements_text(
                      COALESCE(
                          inserted_artifact.payload_jsonb -> 'calculation_ids',
                          '[]'::jsonb
                      )
                  ) WITH ORDINALITY AS reference(value, ordinality);
                INSERT INTO operations.artifact_claim_ref (
                    artifact_record_id, run_id, dataset_version, claim_id,
                    reference_role, ordinal
                )
                SELECT inserted_artifact.artifact_record_id,
                       inserted_artifact.run_id,
                       inserted_artifact.dataset_version,
                       reference.value,
                       'candidate',
                       reference.ordinality - 1
                  FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements_text(
                      COALESCE(
                          inserted_artifact.payload_jsonb -> 'candidate_claim_ids',
                          '[]'::jsonb
                      )
                  ) WITH ORDINALITY AS reference(value, ordinality);
            ELSIF inserted_artifact.artifact_type = 'verification_report' THEN
                INSERT INTO operations.artifact_evidence_ref (
                    artifact_record_id, run_id, dataset_version, evidence_id,
                    reference_role, ordinal
                )
                SELECT inserted_artifact.artifact_record_id,
                       inserted_artifact.run_id,
                       inserted_artifact.dataset_version,
                       flattened.evidence_id,
                       'claim_check',
                       pg_catalog.row_number() OVER (
                           ORDER BY flattened.check_ordinal,
                                    flattened.evidence_ordinal
                       ) - 1
                  FROM (
                      SELECT evidence.value AS evidence_id,
                             check_record.ordinality AS check_ordinal,
                             evidence.ordinality AS evidence_ordinal
                        FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(
                            COALESCE(
                                inserted_artifact.payload_jsonb -> 'claim_checks',
                                '[]'::jsonb
                            )
                        ) WITH ORDINALITY AS check_record(value, ordinality)
                        CROSS JOIN LATERAL
                            pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements_text(
                                COALESCE(
                                    check_record.value -> 'related_evidence_ids',
                                    '[]'::jsonb
                                )
                            ) WITH ORDINALITY AS evidence(value, ordinality)
                  ) AS flattened;
                INSERT INTO operations.artifact_evidence_ref (
                    artifact_record_id, run_id, dataset_version, evidence_id,
                    reference_role, ordinal
                )
                SELECT inserted_artifact.artifact_record_id,
                       inserted_artifact.run_id,
                       inserted_artifact.dataset_version,
                       flattened.evidence_id,
                       'calculation_check',
                       pg_catalog.row_number() OVER (
                           ORDER BY flattened.check_ordinal,
                                    flattened.evidence_ordinal
                       ) - 1
                  FROM (
                      SELECT evidence.value AS evidence_id,
                             check_record.ordinality AS check_ordinal,
                             evidence.ordinality AS evidence_ordinal
                        FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(
                            COALESCE(
                                inserted_artifact.payload_jsonb
                                    -> 'calculation_checks',
                                '[]'::jsonb
                            )
                        ) WITH ORDINALITY AS check_record(value, ordinality)
                        CROSS JOIN LATERAL
                            pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements_text(
                                COALESCE(
                                    check_record.value -> 'related_evidence_ids',
                                    '[]'::jsonb
                                )
                            ) WITH ORDINALITY AS evidence(value, ordinality)
                  ) AS flattened;
                INSERT INTO operations.artifact_calculation_ref (
                    artifact_record_id, run_id, dataset_version, calculation_id,
                    reference_role, ordinal
                )
                SELECT inserted_artifact.artifact_record_id,
                       inserted_artifact.run_id,
                       inserted_artifact.dataset_version,
                       check_record.value ->> 'target_id',
                       'checked',
                       check_record.ordinality - 1
                  FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(
                      COALESCE(
                          inserted_artifact.payload_jsonb -> 'calculation_checks',
                          '[]'::jsonb
                      )
                  ) WITH ORDINALITY AS check_record(value, ordinality)
                 WHERE check_record.value ->> 'target_type' = 'calculation';
                INSERT INTO operations.artifact_claim_ref (
                    artifact_record_id, run_id, dataset_version, claim_id,
                    reference_role, ordinal
                )
                SELECT inserted_artifact.artifact_record_id,
                       inserted_artifact.run_id,
                       inserted_artifact.dataset_version,
                       reference.value,
                       'releaseable',
                       reference.ordinality - 1
                  FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements_text(
                      COALESCE(
                          inserted_artifact.payload_jsonb
                              -> 'releaseable_claim_ids',
                          '[]'::jsonb
                      )
                  ) WITH ORDINALITY AS reference(value, ordinality);
                INSERT INTO operations.artifact_claim_ref (
                    artifact_record_id, run_id, dataset_version, claim_id,
                    reference_role, ordinal
                )
                SELECT inserted_artifact.artifact_record_id,
                       inserted_artifact.run_id,
                       inserted_artifact.dataset_version,
                       rejected.value ->> 'claim_id',
                       'rejected',
                       rejected.ordinality - 1
                  FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(
                      COALESCE(
                          inserted_artifact.payload_jsonb -> 'rejected_claims',
                          '[]'::jsonb
                      )
                  ) WITH ORDINALITY AS rejected(value, ordinality);
            ELSIF inserted_artifact.artifact_type = 'answer_plan' THEN
                INSERT INTO operations.artifact_claim_ref (
                    artifact_record_id, run_id, dataset_version, claim_id,
                    reference_role, ordinal
                )
                SELECT inserted_artifact.artifact_record_id,
                       inserted_artifact.run_id,
                       inserted_artifact.dataset_version,
                       selected.claim_id,
                       'selected',
                       pg_catalog.row_number() OVER (
                           ORDER BY selected.block_ordinal,
                                    selected.row_group,
                                    selected.row_ordinal,
                                    selected.slot_ordinal
                       ) - 1
                  FROM (
                      SELECT block.ordinality AS block_ordinal,
                             0::bigint AS row_group,
                             0::bigint AS row_ordinal,
                             slot.ordinality AS slot_ordinal,
                             slot.value ->> 'claim_id' AS claim_id
                        FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(
                            COALESCE(
                                inserted_artifact.payload_jsonb -> 'blocks',
                                '[]'::jsonb
                            )
                        ) WITH ORDINALITY AS block(value, ordinality)
                        CROSS JOIN LATERAL
                            pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(
                                COALESCE(
                                    block.value -> 'claim_slots', '[]'::jsonb
                                )
                            ) WITH ORDINALITY AS slot(value, ordinality)
                      UNION ALL
                      SELECT block.ordinality AS block_ordinal,
                             1::bigint AS row_group,
                             row_record.ordinality AS row_ordinal,
                             cell.ordinality AS slot_ordinal,
                             cell.value ->> 'claim_id' AS claim_id
                        FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(
                            COALESCE(
                                inserted_artifact.payload_jsonb -> 'blocks',
                                '[]'::jsonb
                            )
                        ) WITH ORDINALITY AS block(value, ordinality)
                        CROSS JOIN LATERAL
                            pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(
                                COALESCE(block.value -> 'rows', '[]'::jsonb)
                            ) WITH ORDINALITY AS row_record(value, ordinality)
                        CROSS JOIN LATERAL
                            pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(
                                COALESCE(
                                    row_record.value -> 'cells', '[]'::jsonb
                                )
                            ) WITH ORDINALITY AS cell(value, ordinality)
                  ) AS selected;
            ELSIF inserted_artifact.artifact_type = 'released_answer' THEN
                INSERT INTO operations.artifact_claim_ref (
                    artifact_record_id, run_id, dataset_version, claim_id,
                    reference_role, ordinal
                )
                SELECT inserted_artifact.artifact_record_id,
                       inserted_artifact.run_id,
                       inserted_artifact.dataset_version,
                       flattened.claim_id,
                       'bound',
                       pg_catalog.row_number() OVER (
                           ORDER BY flattened.binding_ordinal,
                                    flattened.claim_ordinal
                       ) - 1
                  FROM (
                      SELECT claim.value AS claim_id,
                             binding.ordinality AS binding_ordinal,
                             claim.ordinality AS claim_ordinal
                        FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(
                            COALESCE(
                                inserted_artifact.payload_jsonb
                                    -> 'claim_bindings',
                                '[]'::jsonb
                            )
                        ) WITH ORDINALITY AS binding(value, ordinality)
                        CROSS JOIN LATERAL
                            pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements_text(
                                COALESCE(
                                    binding.value -> 'claim_ids', '[]'::jsonb
                                )
                            ) WITH ORDINALITY AS claim(value, ordinality)
                  ) AS flattened;
                INSERT INTO operations.artifact_evidence_ref (
                    artifact_record_id, run_id, dataset_version, evidence_id,
                    reference_role, ordinal
                )
                SELECT inserted_artifact.artifact_record_id,
                       inserted_artifact.run_id,
                       inserted_artifact.dataset_version,
                       flattened.evidence_id,
                       'bound',
                       pg_catalog.row_number() OVER (
                           ORDER BY flattened.binding_ordinal,
                                    flattened.evidence_ordinal
                       ) - 1
                  FROM (
                      SELECT evidence.value AS evidence_id,
                             binding.ordinality AS binding_ordinal,
                             evidence.ordinality AS evidence_ordinal
                        FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(
                            COALESCE(
                                inserted_artifact.payload_jsonb
                                    -> 'claim_bindings',
                                '[]'::jsonb
                            )
                        ) WITH ORDINALITY AS binding(value, ordinality)
                        CROSS JOIN LATERAL
                            pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements_text(
                                COALESCE(
                                    binding.value -> 'evidence_ids', '[]'::jsonb
                                )
                            ) WITH ORDINALITY AS evidence(value, ordinality)
                  ) AS flattened;
            END IF;
            RETURN inserted_artifact.artifact_record_id;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN unique_violation THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'ARTIFACT_CONFLICT'
                    USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
        END
        $function$

functions.name: derive_request_artifact
finish_dataset_validation
finish_request_run
functions.identity_arguments: p_run_id text, p_execution_outcome text, p_verification_status text, p_answer_disposition text, p_http_status smallint, p_final_verification_report_id text, p_terminal_failure_code text, p_finished_at timestamp with time zone
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION operations.finish_request_run(p_run_id text, p_execution_outcome text, p_verification_status text, p_answer_disposition text, p_http_status smallint, p_final_verification_report_id text, p_terminal_failure_code text, p_finished_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS operations.request_run
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'operations', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            request_record operations.request_run%ROWTYPE;
            report_record operations.request_artifact%ROWTYPE;
        BEGIN
            SELECT request.*
              INTO request_record
              FROM operations.request_run AS request
             WHERE request.run_id = p_run_id
             FOR UPDATE;
            IF NOT FOUND THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_RUN_NOT_FOUND'
                    USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
            END IF;

            IF request_record.finished_at IS NOT NULL THEN
                IF request_record.execution_outcome = p_execution_outcome
                   AND request_record.verification_status
                       IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_verification_status
                   AND request_record.answer_disposition
                       IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_answer_disposition
                   AND request_record.http_status = p_http_status
                   AND request_record.terminal_failure_code
                       IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_terminal_failure_code
                   AND request_record.finished_at = p_finished_at
                   AND (
                       p_final_verification_report_id IS NULL
                       AND request_record.final_verification_artifact_id IS NULL
                       OR EXISTS (
                           SELECT 1
                             FROM operations.request_artifact AS artifact
                            WHERE artifact.run_id = p_run_id
                              AND artifact.artifact_record_id =
                                  request_record.final_verification_artifact_id
                              AND artifact.artifact_type = 'verification_report'
                              AND artifact.contract_object_id =
                                  p_final_verification_report_id
                       )
                   )
                THEN
                    RETURN request_record;
                END IF;
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_RUN_CONFLICT'
                    USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
            END IF;

            IF p_http_status = 200 THEN
                IF p_execution_outcome NOT IN (
                       'completed', 'completed_with_failures'
                   )
                   OR p_verification_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'pass'
                   OR p_answer_disposition IS NULL
                   OR p_final_verification_report_id IS NULL
                   OR p_terminal_failure_code IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TERMINAL_STATE'
                        USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
                END IF;
                SELECT artifact.*
                  INTO report_record
                  FROM operations.request_artifact AS artifact
                 WHERE artifact.run_id = p_run_id
                   AND artifact.artifact_type = 'verification_report'
                   AND artifact.contract_object_id =
                       p_final_verification_report_id
                 FOR SHARE;
                IF NOT FOUND
                   OR report_record.payload_jsonb ->> 'verification_status'
                       IS DISTINCT FROM 'pass'
                   OR report_record.payload_jsonb
                       ->> 'recommended_answer_disposition'
                       IS DISTINCT FROM p_answer_disposition
                THEN
                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FINAL_VERIFICATION_ARTIFACT_INVALID'
                        USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
                END IF;
            ELSIF p_http_status BETWEEN 500 AND 599 THEN
                IF p_execution_outcome IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed'
                   OR p_verification_status IS NOT NULL
                   OR p_answer_disposition IS NOT NULL
                   OR p_final_verification_report_id IS NOT NULL
                   OR p_terminal_failure_code IS NULL
                   OR pg_catalog.btrim(p_terminal_failure_code) = ''
                THEN
                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TERMINAL_STATE'
                        USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
                END IF;
            ELSE
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TERMINAL_STATE'
                    USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
            END IF;

            UPDATE operations.request_run
               SET finished_at = p_finished_at,
                   execution_outcome = p_execution_outcome,
                   verification_status = p_verification_status,
                   answer_disposition = p_answer_disposition,
                   http_status = p_http_status,
                   final_verification_artifact_id =
                       report_record.artifact_record_id,
                   terminal_failure_code = p_terminal_failure_code
             WHERE run_id = p_run_id
            RETURNING * INTO request_record;
            RETURN request_record;
        END
        $function$

functions.name: record_dataset_readiness
functions.identity_arguments: p_dataset_version text, p_component text, p_validation_run_id text, p_component_manifest_hash character, p_validated_at timestamp with time zone, p_validator_version text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION operations.record_dataset_readiness(p_dataset_version text, p_component text, p_validation_run_id text, p_component_manifest_hash character, p_validated_at timestamp with time zone, p_validator_version text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'operations', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            dataset_record operations.dataset_version%ROWTYPE;
            validation_record operations.dataset_validation_run%ROWTYPE;
        BEGIN
            SELECT validation.*
              INTO validation_record
              FROM operations.dataset_validation_run AS validation
             WHERE validation.validation_run_id = p_validation_run_id
               AND validation.dataset_version = p_dataset_version
             FOR SHARE;
            IF NOT FOUND OR validation_record.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'pass' THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUCCESSFUL_VALIDATION_REQUIRED'
                    USING ERRCODE = '23503';
            END IF;

            SELECT dataset.*
              INTO dataset_record
              FROM operations.dataset_version AS dataset
             WHERE dataset.dataset_version = p_dataset_version
             FOR SHARE;
            IF NOT FOUND THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATASET_NOT_FOUND'
                    USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
            END IF;
            IF dataset_record.status NOT IN ('building','validated') THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATASET_NOT_READY_FOR_COMPONENT'
                    USING ERRCODE = '55000';
            END IF;
            IF validation_record.dataset_manifest_hash IS DISTINCT FROM
               dataset_record.manifest_hash THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATASET_MANIFEST_MISMATCH'
                    USING ERRCODE = '23514';
            END IF;

            INSERT INTO operations.dataset_readiness (
                dataset_version,
                component,
                validation_run_id,
                validation_status,
                dataset_manifest_hash,
                component_manifest_hash,
                validated_at,
                validator_version
            ) VALUES (
                p_dataset_version,
                p_component,
                p_validation_run_id,
                'pass',
                dataset_record.manifest_hash,
                p_component_manifest_hash,
                p_validated_at,
                p_validator_version
            );
        END
        $function$

start_request_run
functions.identity_arguments: p_run_id text, p_request_key text, p_question_id text, p_question text, p_schema_version text, p_dataset_version text, p_cutoff_date date, p_created_at timestamp with time zone, p_deadline_at timestamp with time zone
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION operations.start_request_run(p_run_id text, p_request_key text, p_question_id text, p_question text, p_schema_version text, p_dataset_version text, p_cutoff_date date, p_created_at timestamp with time zone, p_deadline_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS operations.request_run
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'operations', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            existing_run operations.request_run%ROWTYPE;
            active_version text;
            active_status text;
            active_cutoff date;
        BEGIN
            PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
                pg_catalog.hashtextextended(p_run_id, 0)
            );
            SELECT request.*
              INTO existing_run
              FROM operations.request_run AS request
             WHERE request.run_id = p_run_id;
            IF FOUND THEN
                IF existing_run.request_key = p_request_key AND
                   existing_run.question_id = p_question_id AND
                   existing_run.question = p_question AND
                   existing_run.schema_version = p_schema_version AND
                   existing_run.dataset_version = p_dataset_version AND
                   existing_run.cutoff_date = p_cutoff_date AND
                   existing_run.created_at = p_created_at AND
                   existing_run.deadline_at = p_deadline_at THEN
                    RETURN existing_run;
                END IF;
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_RUN_CONFLICT'
                    USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
            END IF;

            SELECT active.dataset_version
              INTO active_version
              FROM operations.active_dataset AS active
             WHERE active.singleton
             FOR SHARE;
            SELECT dataset.status, dataset.cutoff_date
              INTO active_status, active_cutoff
              FROM operations.dataset_version AS dataset
             WHERE dataset.dataset_version = p_dataset_version
             FOR SHARE;
            IF active_version IS DISTINCT FROM p_dataset_version OR
               active_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'active' OR
               active_cutoff IS DISTINCT FROM p_cutoff_date THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'ACTIVE_DATASET_MISMATCH'
                    USING ERRCODE = '55000';
            END IF;

            INSERT INTO operations.request_run (
                run_id,
                request_key,
                question_id,
                question,
                schema_version,
                dataset_version,
                cutoff_date,
                created_at,
                deadline_at
            ) VALUES (
                p_run_id,
                p_request_key,
                p_question_id,
                p_question,
                p_schema_version,
                p_dataset_version,
                p_cutoff_date,
                p_created_at,
                p_deadline_at
            ) RETURNING * INTO existing_run;
            RETURN existing_run;
        END
        $function$

functions.name: validate_dataset_transition
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION operations.validate_dataset_transition()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'operations', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
        BEGIN
            IF OLD.status = NEW.status OR
               (OLD.status = 'building' AND NEW.status IN ('validated','failed')) OR
               (OLD.status = 'validated' AND NEW.status IN ('active','failed')) OR
               (OLD.status = 'active' AND NEW.status = 'retired') THEN
                RETURN NEW;
            END IF;
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_DATASET_TRANSITION'
                USING ERRCODE = '55000';
        END
        $function$

functions.name: validate_document_embedding
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION search.validate_document_embedding()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'search', 'cdb_admin', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            registered_dimension integer;
            actual_dimension integer;
        BEGIN
            SELECT model.dimension
              INTO registered_dimension
              FROM search.embedding_model AS model
             WHERE model.model_id = NEW.model_id
               AND model.model_version = NEW.model_version
             FOR KEY SHARE;
            actual_dimension := cdb_admin.vector_dims(NEW.embedding);
            IF NEW.dimension IS DISTINCT FROM actual_dimension
               OR NEW.dimension IS DISTINCT FROM registered_dimension THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'EMBEDDING_DIMENSION_MISMATCH'
                    USING ERRCODE = '23514';
            END IF;
            RETURN NEW;
        END
        $function$

views.name: claim_eligible_evidence
views.definition:
SELECT evidence_row.dataset_version,
    evidence_row.evidence_id,
    evidence_row.evidence_kind,
    evidence_row.source_id,
    evidence_row.subject_id,
    evidence_row.predicate_id,
    evidence_row.value_or_object_id,
    evidence_row.normalized_value,
    evidence_row.unit,
    evidence_row.currency,
    evidence_row.applicable_date,
    evidence_row.valid_from,
    evidence_row.valid_to,
    evidence_row.published_at,
    evidence_row.available_at,
    evidence_row.vintage_date,
    evidence_row.locator_type,
    evidence_row.locator_uri_or_object_key,
    evidence_row.locator_record_key,
    evidence_row.locator_sheet,
    evidence_row.locator_row,
    evidence_row.locator_column,
    evidence_row.locator_page,
    evidence_row.locator_section,
    evidence_row.locator_sentence_start,
    evidence_row.locator_sentence_end,
    evidence_row.raw_value_repr,
    evidence_row.parser_version,
    evidence_row.mapping_version,
    evidence_row.cutoff_status,
    evidence_row.record_hash,
    evidence_row.scope_completeness,
    evidence_row.created_at
   FROM evidence.evidence_record evidence_row
     JOIN evidence.source_record source_row ON source_row.dataset_version = evidence_row.dataset_version AND source_row.source_id = evidence_row.source_id
     JOIN operations.dataset_version dataset ON dataset.dataset_version = evidence_row.dataset_version
  WHERE source_row.eligible_for_claim AND evidence_row.cutoff_status = 'eligible'::text AND (evidence_row.applicable_date IS NULL OR evidence_row.applicable_date <= dataset.cutoff_date) AND (evidence_row.published_at IS NULL OR (evidence_row.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)::date <= dataset.cutoff_date) AND (evidence_row.available_at IS NULL OR (evidence_row.available_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)::date <= dataset.cutoff_date) AND (evidence_row.vintage_date IS NULL OR evidence_row.vintage_date <= dataset.cutoff_date);

checks.name: ck_atomic_claim_subject_scope
checks.definition: CHECK ((claim_type = ANY (ARRAY['direct_fact'::text, 'relation'::text, 'derived_metric'::text, 'rank'::text, 'similarity'::text])) AND subject_kind = 'entity'::text AND subject_entity_id IS NOT NULL AND subject_entity_id = subject_id AND request_subject_id IS NULL OR (claim_type = ANY (ARRAY['no_match'::text, 'data_limitation'::text, 'policy_boundary'::text])) AND subject_kind = 'request'::text AND subject_entity_id IS NULL AND request_subject_id IS NOT NULL AND request_subject_id = subject_id AND subject_id = subtask_id)

checks.name: ck_atomic_claim_target
checks.definition: CHECK (num_nonnulls(object_id, value) = 1 OR (claim_type = ANY (ARRAY['data_limitation'::text, 'policy_boundary'::text])) AND object_id IS NULL AND value IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_atomic_claim_value
checks.definition: CHECK (value IS NULL OR evidence.is_valid_tagged_value(value) AND (value ->> 'type'::text) <> 'tuple'::text)

checks.name: ck_claim_support_target
checks.definition: CHECK (support_kind = 'calculation'::text AND calculation_id IS NOT NULL AND evidence_id IS NULL OR support_kind <> 'calculation'::text AND evidence_id IS NOT NULL AND calculation_id IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_evidence_record_origin_subject
checks.definition: CHECK ((evidence_kind <> ALL (ARRAY['observation'::text, 'relation'::text, 'document_span'::text])) OR subject_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_evidence_record_scope_completeness
checks.definition: CHECK (evidence_kind = 'query_scope'::text AND scope_completeness IS NOT NULL AND (scope_completeness = ANY (ARRAY['closed_world'::text, 'bounded_unknown'::text])) OR evidence_kind <> 'query_scope'::text AND scope_completeness IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_evidence_record_valid_dates
checks.definition: CHECK (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_from IS NULL OR valid_to >= valid_from)

checks.name: ck_observation_record_period_dates
checks.definition: CHECK (period_end IS NULL OR period_start IS NULL OR period_end >= period_start)

checks.name: ck_observation_record_target_xor
checks.definition: CHECK ((entity_id IS NOT NULL) <> (relation_id IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: ck_observation_record_typed_value_status
checks.definition: CHECK (value_status = 'present'::text AND num_nonnulls(numeric_value, text_value, boolean_value, date_value, timestamp_value) = 1 AND (numeric_value IS NULL OR numeric_value <> 0::numeric) AND reason_code IS NULL OR value_status = 'zero'::text AND numeric_value = 0::numeric AND text_value IS NULL AND boolean_value IS NULL AND date_value IS NULL AND timestamp_value IS NULL AND reason_code IS NULL OR (value_status = ANY (ARRAY['missing'::text, 'placeholder'::text, 'unavailable'::text, 'inapplicable'::text, 'unknown'::text])) AND num_nonnulls(numeric_value, text_value, boolean_value, date_value, timestamp_value) = 0 AND reason_code IS NOT NULL AND reason_code <> ''::text)

checks.name: ck_request_artifact_model_metadata
checks.definition: CHECK ((model_id IS NULL) = (prompt_version IS NULL) AND (artifact_type = 'query_plan'::text AND model_id IS NOT NULL OR artifact_type = 'answer_plan'::text OR (artifact_type <> ALL (ARRAY['query_plan'::text, 'answer_plan'::text])) AND model_id IS NULL))

checks.name: ck_request_run_failed_without_disposition
checks.definition: CHECK (execution_outcome IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed'::text OR answer_disposition IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_request_run_finished_at
checks.definition: CHECK (finished_at IS NULL OR finished_at >= created_at)

checks.name: ck_request_run_http_status
checks.definition: CHECK (http_status IS NULL OR http_status >= 100 AND http_status <= 599)

checks.name: ck_request_run_terminal_state
checks.definition: CHECK (finished_at IS NULL AND execution_outcome IS NULL AND verification_status IS NULL AND answer_disposition IS NULL AND http_status IS NULL AND terminal_failure_code IS NULL AND final_verification_artifact_id IS NULL OR finished_at IS NOT NULL AND (execution_outcome = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'completed_with_failures'::text])) AND verification_status = 'pass'::text AND answer_disposition IS NOT NULL AND http_status = 200 AND terminal_failure_code IS NULL AND final_verification_artifact_id IS NOT NULL OR finished_at IS NOT NULL AND execution_outcome = 'failed'::text AND verification_status IS NULL AND answer_disposition IS NULL AND http_status >= 500 AND http_status <= 599 AND terminal_failure_code IS NOT NULL AND btrim(terminal_failure_code) <> ''::text AND final_verification_artifact_id IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_relation_record_valid_dates
checks.definition: CHECK (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_from IS NULL OR valid_to >= valid_from)
